subtopic: ANSI SQL Isolation Levels (Read Committed to Serializable)
question_text: Under Serializable isolation via Two-Phase Locking (2PL), when may a transaction release its acquired locks?

options.text: During the growing phase before making updates
Only during the shrinking phase after all locks have been acquired, or at transaction commit/rollback (Strict 2PL)

answer_explanation: In 2PL, once a transaction releases any lock, it enters the shrinking phase and may acquire no further locks. Strict 2PL holds all exclusive write locks until transaction completion to prevent cascading aborts.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: C. Rationale: In 2PL, once a transaction releases any lock, it enters the shrinking phase and may acquire no further locks. Strict 2PL holds all exclusive write locks until transaction completion to prevent cascading aborts.
